No flaggable anomalies. Gain spreads 0.056% (f8) and 0.083% (f9), far under the ~2% flag threshold; rel_err max 1.02e-2, under 5e-2; zero OOM; zero CUDA/driver errors outside tuning. All 5 (f8) and 6 (f9) mcErrorMemoryValueTooLarge / "private memory 4 KB/thread cap" messages fall strictly between [cfgs] tuning lines (verified by log line number and timestamp) — expected autotuner candidate rejections. Monotonicity not assessable within this lane: only one T point (262144) was assigned; cross-lane monotonicity must be checked by the orchestrator against lanes 1/2. Runs were strictly sequential on GPU 0 (f8 PID 1641390 confirmed exited and GPU memory back to 1.2 GiB before f9 PID 1709169 launched); peak memory 46.6 GiB (f8) and 49.4 GiB (f9) of 65.5 GiB. OBSERVATION, not an anomaly: at T=262144 both fusions are net LOSSES — fused is ~15% SLOWER than unfused (f8 0.8534x; f9 0.8520x vs 2-kernel, 0.8608x vs 3-kernel). This is ~14-15% away from parity, i.e. ~6-7x the stated ~2.2% between-run variation, so the sign of the effect is well resolved even though the exact magnitude carries that ~2.2% uncertainty. The f9 vs-2k and vs-3k gains differ by ~1.0%, which is BELOW the ~2.2% between-run resolution — do not read the 2k/3k baseline ordering as resolved. Tuned configs converged to the same tile for both sides (BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=256, BLOCK_K=32, num_warps=16, num_stages=3; GROUP_M 4 unfused vs 16 fused), and the f9 seed step selected the torch impl (4.4856 ms) over triton (10.0037 ms).

None to flag. All four points are clean against every stated criterion.

- Gain spread: max 0.227% (F8 T=32768); all well under the ~2% threshold.
- rel_err: max 1.06e-2 (F8 T=32768 fused side); all well under 5e-2.
- OOM: none. Peak observed device memory was 26.2 GiB (F8) / 27.7 GiB (F9) of 64 GiB. GPU 1 returned to its 858 MiB idle baseline after each run.
- Driver errors: "mcErrorMemoryValueTooLarge" / "private memory ... 4 KB/Thread, kernel request 5-6 KB/thread" lines appeared ONLY during autotuning in both logs, each immediately followed by a successful "[cfgs] ..." selection line. Zero occurrences of OOM, Traceback, or CUDA error anywhere in either log (grep count 0 in both).
- Monotonicity: F8 gain moves smoothly with T (0.9014 -> 0.8798 -> 0.8565 as T goes 32768 -> 65536 -> 131072); both unfused and fused times scale ~1.88-1.97x per doubling of T. No jumps.

Cross-run consistency check (informational, not a flag): at T=131072 the F8 and F9 numbers agree closely -- F8 unfused 375.62 vs F9 2-kernel baseline 376.38 (0.20% apart), F8 fused 438.67 vs F9 fused 439.88 (0.28% apart). Both differences are far inside the ~2.2% between-run variation on this machine.

Interpretation caveat honored: every fusion here is a SLOWDOWN (gain < 1.0 at all four points, i.e. fused is 11-17% slower than unfused), and those margins are large enough to be real. But the F9 gap between the 2-kernel (0.8555x) and 3-kernel (0.8646x) baselines is ~1.1%, which is below the ~2% resolution floor -- I am not claiming a difference between those two baselines. Likewise, no trend claim is made from any sub-2% wiggle.

Both runs executed strictly sequentially; the f8 process was confirmed exited and GPU 1 back to idle before f9 was launched. No source files, flags, or configs were modified.
